record.status: Seven whole frame/variant/cycle bodies reconstructed and verified offline; higher controller and complete animation playback remain unfinished.
changes: Replace uninitialized in_ECX with named C interfaces taking a typed animation-cycle receiver.
Canonical adapters capture ECX before C code and retain existing cdecl stack cleanup; new C callers must use the explicit interfaces.
Preserve signed16 frame normalization, low16 variant indexing, direct signed16 selected-frame assignment and finite-repeat counter reloads.
Small numeric x87 helpers preserve PC/RC, unordered comparison and comparison of extended intermediate before binary32 rounding; no original code executes.

verification.scope: 32 frame-normalization cases plus null variant;18 variant/frame and6 variant selections;216 forward/reverse cycle cases;96 step cases spanning PC24/53/64 and four rounding modes at sub-ULP boundaries;6 ordinary step cases. Every case compares original against canonical adapter and separately against named C API, memory, defined EAX, stack/nonvolatile registers, CW and balanced x87 TOP.
verification.limits: Well-formed pointers and positive frame counts. Zero-length nonterminating native loops, unmasked traps and FPSW equivalence are outside the verified domain. Higher controller55D4F0, action/direction selection and unreconstructed upstream callers are not certified; no live-game/physical-animation claim.

record.next: Reconstruct complete55D4F0 timing/return pipeline and its55D760/55D780/55D7B0/55D810 callers; Rea has already read their complete bodies.
record.publication: Sources pushed to main; no tag or GitHub release created. Exact tested EXE promoted to local Release.

record.status: Four complete timing/completion methods reconstructed and verified offline. Action/direction selection and full playback remain unfinished.
changes: Preserve initial action-rate*playback-rate*binary32(1/6000) in raw80; timed mode multiplies by unsigned DWORD elapsed / signed lowDWORD of truncated1000/fps.
Use full DWORD timing flag at6044B0, not a BYTE. Compare the extended step against zero before binary32 argument rounding.
Real forward/reverse advancement and wrapping return the true completion flag. Complete bool/stop/hold callers no longer abort on unknown55D4F0 return.
Preserve signed low16 frame test, early last-frame flag0100 and later set-frame behavior. Keep cdecl normalized legacy adapters and named explicit receiver API.

verification.scope: Whole timing and all actual seven cycle callees; native FTOL versus existing exact raw80 conversion. All four methods through canonical and explicit API; full globals/object memory, defined EAX, stack, nonvolatile registers, CW, x87 TOP/tags.144 base cases;48 elapsed/fps cases including unsigned-high time;144 precision/rounding/profile cases;7 last-frame/conversion cases;4 inherited nonempty x87 stack cases.
verification.limits: Well-formed objects, positive frame counts and masked FP exceptions. FPSW/traps and complete action/direction or physical playback are not certified.
verification.final_target: PASS347 timing +375 cycle cases and noargument link check on this exact hash
